rows.grounds: adverb of manner; introduces the concluding statement about the yantras
neuter nominative/accusative plural of etad, referring to the yantras just enumerated
neuter nominative plural of yantra; the ritual diagrams/devices under discussion
adverbial ablative sense from nāman; indicates classification or designation by name
compound of sarva, kārya, and kṛt; describes the yantras as accomplishing every work

items.question: What functional designation is given to these yantras when they are named?
premises: etāni yantrāṇi names the devices under discussion
items.inference: These yantras are, by name, designated as all-work-doing devices.
uncertainties: The exact syntactic agreement of sarvakāryakṛt with the plural yantrāṇi is not fully resolved by the five-token line alone.
items.plain_english: Thus these yantras are, by name, all-work-doing.
